shopProfile.title: Shop profile
shopProfile.description: Your store's identity and business contact details.
shopProfile.renameNote: Need to rename your store or change its address? Contact support — the address is tied to links customers may have already saved.
shopProfile.contactDescription: Shown to customers on your storefront and used for order-related email.
shopProfile.currencyHint: Used on your storefront, in the POS, and at checkout.
shopProfile.verticalHint: Tunes the AI tools (photo listings, imports, chat) to your kind of store. Your category list is edited separately under Categories.
shopProfile.rangeHint: One or two sentences in your own words — the AI uses this to write better listings.
shopProfile.rangePlaceholder: e.g. Wheel-thrown stoneware tableware in muted glazes
shopProfile.currencyNote: Prices are stored as plain numbers, so changing this relabels them — it does not convert them.
shopProfile.currencyChangeNote: A product at {{old}} would become {{new}}, not its exchange-rate equivalent. Re-price your catalogue after saving.
shopProfile.companyDescription: Published on your storefront's legal notice. Add whatever your country requires and leave the rest blank.
shopProfile.companyLegalNameHint: The legal entity behind the shop, if it differs from your store name.
shopProfile.companyAddressHint: Your business address, as it should appear on the legal notice.
shopProfile.vatNumberHint: Only if your business is registered for VAT.
shopProfile.companyRegistrationHint: Your entry in the commercial register, if you have one.

storefront.title: Storefront
storefront.description: How your public website looks and appears in search.
storefront.invalidLogo: Logo must be a full URL (https://…).
storefront.invalidColor: Primary colour must be a hex value like #8B6914.
storefront.invalidSecondaryColor: Secondary colour must be a hex value like #B8963E.
storefront.brandingDescription: Your logo and brand colours appear across your storefront.
storefront.logoUrlHint: A hosted image URL. Upload elsewhere and paste the link here.
storefront.secondaryColourHint: The highlight: links, labels, and price accents. Leave blank to derive it from the primary.
storefront.seoDescription: What people see when your store appears in Google or is shared as a link.
storefront.metaTitleHint: Appears in the browser tab and search results.
storefront.metaDescriptionHint: A one- or two-sentence summary for search engines.
storefront.metaDescriptionPlaceholder: Carefully selected items, made with care.
storefront.displayNameHint: What customers see on your storefront, receipts and emails. Leave blank to use "{{name}}".
storefront.invalidHeroImage: The banner image must be a full URL (https://…).
storefront.contentDescription: The banner and the words on your home page, and your About page. Leave anything blank and we write it for you.
storefront.heroImageUrlHint: A wide photo behind your home page headline. A hosted image URL, like the logo above.
storefront.heroHeadlineHint: The large text on your home page. Defaults to "{{name}}".
storefront.heroHeadlinePlaceholder: Made by hand, one piece at a time
storefront.heroSubtitleHint: One or two lines under the headline.
storefront.heroSubtitlePlaceholder: Browse the collection and check out securely, or visit us in the studio.
storefront.aboutBodyHint: Your story, in your own words. Leave an empty line between paragraphs. Shown to every visitor exactly as written — it is not translated.
storefront.aboutBodyPlaceholder: We opened in 2018 with one kiln and a small table…
storefront.creditDescription: A small credit in your footer, and the machine-readable note that tells search engines and AI assistants which platform your shop runs on.
storefront.creditToggleHint: One line under your copyright, linking to {{url}} — plus the generator tag and structured data that search engines and AI assistants read.
storefront.creditProOnly: Hiding the credit is part of Pro. On Free it stays on — it is how other makers find {{brand}}.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: How your products are grouped — on your website, at the POS, and in the AI tools.
categories.listDescription: Renaming a category updates every product in it. "{{fallback}}" cannot be removed — AI imports fall back to it.
categories.addDescription: The name is what the AI, POS, and website use; the German, French and Italian labels are shown to shoppers browsing in those languages.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Use your own web address for your storefront.
domain.savedToast: Domain saved. DNS can take a little while to propagate.
domain.invalidDomain: Enter a bare domain like shop.example.com (no https://).
domain.domainHint: Enter a bare domain — for example shop.yourbrand.com.
domain.connectedNote: DNS points at {{brand}} and a certificate will be issued automatically.
domain.waitingNote: Point a CNAME record for {{domain}} at {{expected}}, then this will turn green.
domain.waitingNoteNoExpected: Point your domain's CNAME at the platform and this will turn green.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Connect the places your customers find you and your products come from.
channels.slackConnectedToast: Slack connected — now tell us which channel to watch.
channels.slackFailedToast: Slack connection failed — try again or paste a bot token.
channels.discordChannelInvalid: A Discord channel ID is a 17–20 digit number.
channels.discordUserInvalid: A Discord user ID is a 17–20 digit number.
channels.slackChannelInvalid: A Slack channel ID looks like C0123ABCDEF.
channels.contactDescription: Where customers reach you from the storefront.
channels.whatsappHint: Used for the storefront enquiry button (with country code).
channels.igGridDescription: Curate posts to feature on your storefront home page.
channels.discordDescription: Post a photo, description, and price in your connected channel and the bot adds the product to your catalogue automatically.
channels.discordChannelHint: Right-click your channel → Copy Channel ID (Developer Mode on).
channels.discordOwnerHint: For order notifications sent to you directly.
channels.discordInviteLink: invite the {{brand}} bot to your server →
channels.discordThen: then paste your channel ID above.
channels.slackDescription: Post a photo, description, and price in a Slack channel and the bot adds the product to your catalogue automatically.
channels.slackOneClick: One click: approve {{brand}} in your workspace and the connection is stored automatically — no tokens to copy.
channels.slackChannelHint: In Slack: open the channel → its name at the top → About → Channel ID (looks like C0123ABCDEF). Invite the bot to that channel with /invite.

credentials.title: Your own bot credentials (advanced)
credentials.description: By default your store uses {{brand}}'s WhatsApp, Slack and Discord apps — nothing to configure. Paste credentials here only if you run your own. They're stored encrypted and can never be read back, only replaced or removed.
credentials.vaultWarning: This deployment has no secrets vault configured (TENANT_SECRETS_KEY), so credentials can't be stored yet. The platform-level defaults still work.
credentials.whatsappNote: From your own Meta app (WhatsApp > API setup) if you don't use the platform's.
credentials.slackNote: From your own Slack app installed in your workspace.
credentials.discordNote: From your own bot in the Discord Developer Portal. The bot connects within a minute of saving.
credentials.signingSecretPlaceholder: From your app's Basic Information page
credentials.savedHint: Saved (…{{hint}}) — enter a new value to rotate.
credentials.notSetHint: Not set — the platform default applies.
credentials.removedToast: Credential removed — the platform default applies again.

legal.title: Legal & invoices
legal.description: The documents that govern your use of {{brand}}, and where to find your invoices.
legal.invoicesNote: Your subscription invoices are issued and archived by Stripe.
legal.aiNote: Product photos styled with {{brand}}'s AI are enhancements of your own images. You're responsible for ensuring listings accurately represent the item a customer receives.

keys.title: Keys & access
keys.description: Credentials that connect your terminals and tools to this store.
keys.rotatedToast: New POS key generated. Copy it now — it won't be shown again.
keys.posDescription: Your point-of-sale app authenticates with this key. It's stored hashed — we can't show an existing key, only replace it.
keys.rotateWarning: Rotating the key immediately stops the old one from working. Every terminal will need the new key re-entered before it can take payments again.
keys.newKeyLabel: Your new key — copy it now
keys.pairAfter: and point the camera here — the server address and key are set in one go. The code disappears when you leave this page, and anyone who scans it can take payments for your store, so treat it like the key itself.
keys.apiDescription: Programmatic access to your catalogue and orders.
keys.apiNote: A public API for building your own integrations is part of a future Business plan and is coming soon. It'll live here when it's ready.
keys.pairCardDescription: Set up a till without typing the key: generate a link, then tap or scan it on the phone that will take payments.
keys.pairScanInstead: Or scan this code with the {{brand}} POS app on another phone.
keys.pairError: Could not generate a pairing link.
keys.pairNeedsRotation: One-tap pairing needs a key this store generated recently. Rotate your POS key above once, and a pairing link will be available here.

dataPrivacy.title: Data & privacy
dataPrivacy.description: Your data is yours. Export it any time, or ask us to delete your store.
dataPrivacy.exportDescription: Download your catalogue and store profile as a JSON file.
dataPrivacy.exportError: Could not build the export. Please try again.
dataPrivacy.deleteDescription: Permanently remove your store, catalogue, and data from {{brand}}.
dataPrivacy.deleteWarning: Deletion is permanent and can't be undone. To protect against mistakes and confirm ownership, we handle it as a support request.

team.title: Team
team.description: Invite people to help run your shop. Seats are included with your plan.
team.seatsFullNotice_one: All {{count}} seat on your plan are in use. Upgrade to add more teammates.
team.seatsFullNotice_other: All {{count}} seats on your plan are in use. Upgrade to add more teammates.
team.inviteCreatedToast: Invite created — copy the link to share it.

support.title: Support
support.description: Get help running your shop. We're makers too.
support.levelPriority: Priority human support, answered within one business day.
support.levelStandard: Community & email support, answered within a few business days.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: What other people say about your shop — shown at the foot of your home page.
reviews.trustpilotDescription: Link your Trustpilot profile and your rating appears on your storefront, with a link customers can review you through.
reviews.trustpilotHint: Paste your profile link (ch.trustpilot.com/review/…) or the domain you registered with Trustpilot. Leave empty to disconnect.
reviews.showRating: Show the star rating on my storefront
reviews.noRatingYet: No reviews on Trustpilot yet — your storefront shows the link on its own.
reviews.ratingsUnavailable: Live ratings aren't available on this installation, so your storefront shows the link on its own.
reviews.quotesDescription: Words your own customers gave you. Add a photo or their Google ID if they agreed to be named.
reviews.photoHint: Optional. Without one, the storefront shows their initials.
reviews.googleIdHint: Optional — for a quote from a Google review. Never shown to shoppers.
reviews.emptyDescription: Add the first kind thing a customer said to you — an email reply or a WhatsApp message counts.
reviews.emptyNote: the nicest thing someone said this month
reviews.nameAndQuoteRequired: A quote needs a name and some words.
reviews.invalidPhoto: A photo URL has to start with http:// or https://.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.description: Codes for promotions, and for friends and family.
discounts.createDescription: One code for a campaign, or a batch of single-use codes to hand out individually.
discounts.countHint: More than one generates a batch.
discounts.codeHint: Leave empty and we'll generate one.
discounts.prefixHint: Each code starts with this, e.g. XMAS-7K3P9QME.
discounts.maxRedemptionsHint: Empty means unlimited. 1 makes it single-use.
discounts.listDescription: Copy a code, or a link that applies it by itself.
discounts.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the code and copy it by hand.
discounts.invalidValue: Enter a discount greater than zero.
discounts.percentTooHigh: A percentage discount can't be more than 100%.
discounts.emptyDescription: Create one for a promotion, or a single-use code for a friend.
